correctness.rationale: The entropy gradient produces the three population deviations with the apex weight 1/a₃, cancelling both cross terms. The numerator of F(u)−v_* is a quadratic of leading coefficient −a₁ and roots u_−,u_+, so its factorization gives the claimed signed derivative. The entropy is proper on the positive octant and its strict threshold B is the minimum on u≤u_−; any initial closed sublevel below B is compact and positively invariant. On it the zero set forces u≡u_+, then v≡v_* and w≡w_* on an invariant trajectory, so LaSalle applies. Every larger complete sublevel reaches u<u_−. The strict open certificate is a proper subset of the basin: at (u_−,v_*,w_*) on its boundary, u'=0 and u''=u_−v_*(u_+−u_−)>0, giving immediate entry into u>u_− and then H<B. On a periodic orbit, integrating the signed derivative excludes staying on either side unless u and hence the state are constant. Integrating the three log derivatives yields the stated means, and strict F''<0 yields the strict Jensen conclusion since nonconstant state entails nonconstant prey. The periodic assertions are conditional. Read RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and VERIFY.py; the script was inspected, not run, and its single integration is not used as a global certificate.

value.rationale: The explicit initial-state inequality addresses a natural gap left by local stability and numerical basin plots in a bistable model. It provides a rigorous nonlocal guarantee with a precisely delimited sharpness claim. The same identity, combined with concavity, gives testable restrictions on candidate positive cycles without pretending to classify the full basin or prove cycle existence.
